name: The Escape
summary: Maybell Maclure waits for a way to slip away from her family and meet Tommy Joe Stonefield. You bring her William Pestle's Invisibility Liquor, brewed from crystal kelp gathered across the region.

sections.title: A Concoction for True Love
sections.body: The Maclures and Stonefields have feuded for generations, leaving no room for courtship. Gramma Stonefield turns to William Pestle, an alchemist in the Lion's Pride Inn in Goldshire. With crystal kelp from nearby lakes, Pestle brews Invisibility Liquor strong enough to hide Maybell's escape from the Maclure homestead.

sections.title: Vanishing into the Woods
sections.body: Maybell Maclure takes the flask and slips into the trees toward Tommy Joe. Guilt over deceiving her kin troubles her, but her devotion outweighs her fear of discovery. She drinks the liquor and vanishes before your eyes, gaining a few moments with Tommy Joe beyond the watchful eyes of their feuding elders.

faq.q: Who gives the quest The Escape?
aliases: where to pick up the escape
faq.answer: William Pestle, the apothecary and alchemical assistant in Goldshire's Lion's Pride Inn, gives you the Invisibility Liquor after you bring him crystal kelp.

faq.q: What is the Invisibility Liquor used for?
faq.answer: The Invisibility Liquor lets Maybell Maclure turn invisible long enough to leave her family's farm and visit Tommy Joe Stonefield without provoking her relatives.

faq.q: Why do Maybell and Tommy Joe have to hide their relationship?
aliases: why can't maybell and tommy joe be together
faq.answer: The Maclure and Stonefield families are bitter rivals, and their deep hostility forbids an open courtship between their children.

faq.q: What happens when you deliver the potion to Maybell?
faq.answer: Maybell thanks you, torn between guilt and excitement, then drinks the brew. She vanishes before your eyes to slip away toward Tommy Joe.

faq.q: What quest leads directly into The Escape?
faq.answer: The Escape follows Collecting Kelp, where you gather crystal kelp from murlocs at Crystal Lake for William Pestle to brew the invisibility potion.

faq.q: Does this quest resolve the feud between the families?
faq.answer: No. The potion gives the lovers only a brief, secret meeting. The feud between Gramma Stonefield and the Maclures remains bitter and unresolved.

angles.text: As an Alliance adventurer starting in Elwynn Forest, helping Tommy Joe and Maybell offers a lighthearted break from fighting Defias bandits and gnolls. Rural grudges persist even near Stormwind.
As a human in Elwynn, you know stubborn family grudges run deep, and small acts of secret aid between neighbors can help keep the peace.
